Organization: Total floor area: 215m2 2 Bedrooms 1 Living room 2 Toilets 1 Veranda 1 Technical room Large Veranda Orientation and surface area of ​​the duplex provide the possibility of proper comfort. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Ideal opportunity for residence and investment. For more information or meeting at the property, contact me!
